class.name: SteamLobbyOptions
class.brief_description: Fluent configuration for creating a standalone Steam social lobby.

method.name: configure
method.description: Start with an invite-only lobby in [code]crimson[/code] with four seats, including the local creator.

method.name: with_visibility
method.description: Return a branch with the selected Steam lobby visibility. Unrecognized values make the branch invalid at creation.

method.name: in_namespace
method.description: Return a branch with a matchmaking namespace of 1 to 64 ASCII letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.

method.name: for_players
method.description: Return a branch with 1 to 65 member seats, including the creator.

constants.constant: Steam friends and invitees can join.
Steam clients can find the lobby in compatible searches.
Compatible searches can find the lobby without Steam friends visibility.
